		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainWindow.Position
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainWindow.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.Width.Scale, startPos.Width.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Height.Scale, startPos.Height.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 40)

		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

end)
-- LocalScript inside StarterPlayer -> StarterPlayerScripts (PART 2)
local bv, bg, renderConnection

local function stopFlying()
	_G.isFlying = false
	toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	
	if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect() end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() end
	
	character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function startFlying()
	character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	
	local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
	
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	bv.Parent = hrp
	
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp
	
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
		
		-- 1. Noclip Loop
		if _G.isNoclip then
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- 2. Thumbstick Logic (Horizontal Only)
		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		
		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
			local flatRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
			flatRight = Vector3.new(flatRight.X, 0, flatRight.Z).Unit
			
			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)
			flatVelocity = (flatLook * -localMoveDirection.Z) + (flatRight * localMoveDirection.X)
			
			if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * _G.flySpeed
			end
		end
		
		-- 3. Button Logic (Vertical Only)
		local verticalVelocityY = _G.verticalDirection * _G.flySpeed
		
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(flatVelocity.X, verticalVelocityY, flatVelocity.Z)
		
		-- 4. Dynamic Tilt Engine (Faces camera look view)
		local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camLook)
	end)
end

-- BUTTON TRIGGERS & INPUT EVENT BINDINGS
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isFlying = not _G.isFlying
	if _G.isFlying then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		startFlying()
	else
		stopFlying()
	end
end)

-- Noclip Activation Logic
noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = not _G.isNoclip
	if _G.isNoclip then
		noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: ON"
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		if not _G.isFlying then
			_G.isFlying = true
			toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
			toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
			startFlying()
		end
	else
		noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: OFF"
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (UP Button)
upBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = 1
	end
end)
upBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == 1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (DOWN Button)
downBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = -1
	end
end)
downBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == -1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Dynamic Slider Drag Calculations
local function updateSpeed(input)
	local relativeX = input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
	local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
	_G.flySpeed = math.round(percentage * _G.maxSpeed)
	if _G.flySpeed < 5 then _G.flySpeed = 5 end
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. _G.flySpeed
end

local isDragging = false
sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = true
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = false
	end
end)

-- UI Window State Handlers (Updated icons for Tween states)
local isMinimized = false
minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		mainWindow:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 35), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
		minimizeBtn.Text = "▢"
	else
		mainWindow:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 290), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
		minimizeBtn.Text = "▬"
	end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = false
	stopFlying()
	screenGui:Destroy()
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	_G.isNoclip = false
	stopFlying()
end)

local function PlayEmote(id)
    if CurrentTrack then
        pcall(function()
            CurrentTrack:Stop()
            CurrentTrack:Destroy()

        CurrentTrack = nil

    Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not Humanoid then
        return
    end

    if Humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
        warn("R15 karakter gerekli.")
        return
    end

    local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not Animator then
        Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        Animator.Parent = Humanoid
    end

    local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)

    local success, track = pcall(function()
        return Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
    end)

    if success and track then
        CurrentTrack = track
        CurrentTrack.Looped = true
        CurrentTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        CurrentTrack:Play()
    end

	windLevel = 0

	if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
	clearPose()
	clearWind()
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			hum.AutoRotate = true

local function startFly()
	flying = true
	stage = 1
	btn.Text = "BOOST 1"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 210)

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bg.P = 20000
	bg.D = 1500
	bg.Parent = hrp

	local hovering = false
	local flightPose = false

	flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp.Parent then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		local camCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.05
		local speed = speeds[stage] or 55

		if moving then
			if windLevel > 0 and not windShowing then
				setWind(hrp, windLevel)
			end
			lockTorso(char)
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local flyDir = (camCF.LookVector * move:Dot(flatLook)) + (camCF.RightVector * move:Dot(flatRight))
			if flyDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				flyDir = flyDir.Unit
				bv.Velocity = flyDir * speed
				bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + flyDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
				if lookPart then
					lookPart.Position = hrp.Position + flyDir * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end

			if hovering then
				clearPose()
				hovering = false
			end
			if not flightPose then
				applyFlightPose(char, hum)
				flightPose = true
			end
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			bg.CFrame = camCF
			if windShowing then
				local saved = windLevel
				clearWind()
				windLevel = saved
			end
			if flightPose then
				clearPose()
				flightPose = false
			end
			if not hovering then
				applyHoverPose(char, hum)
				hovering = true
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function IsVisible(targetPart)
    if not ESP_SETTINGS.WallCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not targetPart or not LocalPlayer.Character then return false end

    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local destination = targetPart.Position
    local direction = destination - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetPart.Parent}
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    return result == nil
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)

local function ConnectJoints(p1, p2, line, color)
    if not (p1 and p2) then line.Visible = false return end
    local pos1, vis1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position)
    local pos2, vis2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)

    if vis1 and vis2 then
        local startVec = Vector2.new(pos1.X, pos1.Y)
        local endVec = Vector2.new(pos2.X, pos2.Y)
        local distance = (startVec - endVec).Magnitude
        local center = (startVec + endVec) / 2
        local angle = math.atan2(endVec.Y - startVec.Y, endVec.X - startVec.X)

        line.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
        line.Position = UDim2.new(0, center.X, 0, center.Y)
        line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
        line.BackgroundColor3 = color
        line.Visible = true
    else
        line.Visible = false
    end
end

        else

                        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            LockBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragInput = input
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end
            end)

            local shiftEnabled = false
            local shiftConn = nil

            LockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                shiftEnabled = not shiftEnabled
                if shiftEnabled then
                    LockBtn.Text = "🔓"
                    LockStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
                    shiftConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z))
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    LockBtn.Text = "🔒"
                    LockStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
                    if shiftConn then shiftConn:Disconnect() shiftConn = nil end
                end
            end)

        else
            StatusLabel.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "الرمز غير صحيح! حاول مرة أخرى ❌" or "Incorrect Key! Try Again ❌"
            StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        end
    end)
end

    openKeySystem()

scripts.script:
--==================================================
-- FLY
-- V2
--==================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--==================================================
-- CONFIGURACIÓN
--==================================================

local SPEED = 60

local DRAG_DISTANCE = 8

--==================================================
-- VARIABLES
--==================================================

local flying = false

local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local flyConnection

-- Variables del arrastre
local dragging = false
local pressed = false
local dragInput = nil
local dragStart
local startPosition
local dragStarted = false

--==================================================
-- CREAR GUI
--==================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- BOTÓN FLY
--==================================================

local flyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
flyButton.Name = "FlyButton"

flyButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 50)

flyButton.Position = UDim2.new(
	1,
	-110,
	1,
	-160
)

flyButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)

flyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
flyButton.TextScaled = true
flyButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
flyButton.Text = "FLY"

flyButton.AutoButtonColor = true
flyButton.Parent = gui

--==================================================
-- BORDE REDONDEADO
--==================================================

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = flyButton

--==================================================
-- INICIAR VUELO
--==================================================

local function startFly()

	if flying then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end

	flying = true

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	--==================================================
	-- VELOCIDAD
	--==================================================

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"

	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
		math.huge,
		math.huge,
		math.huge
	)

	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	--==================================================
	-- ORIENTACIÓN
	--==================================================

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")

	bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"

	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(
		math.huge,
		math.huge,
		math.huge
	)

	bodyGyro.P = 9000
	bodyGyro.D = 500

	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	--==================================================
	-- ACTUALIZAR VUELO
	--==================================================

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

		if not flying then
			return
		end

		if not root.Parent then
			return
		end

		local direction = Vector3.zero

		--==================================================
		-- JOYSTICK MÓVIL
		--==================================================

		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection

		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then

			local cameraLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector

			local flatLook = Vector3.new(
				cameraLook.X,
				0,
				cameraLook.Z
			)

			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatLook = flatLook.Unit
			end

			local flatRight = Vector3.new(
				cameraRight.X,
				0,
				cameraRight.Z
			)

			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatRight = flatRight.Unit
			end

			local forwardAmount = moveDirection:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmount = moveDirection:Dot(flatRight)

			direction =
				cameraLook * forwardAmount
				+
				flatRight * rightAmount
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTROLES PC
		--==================================================

		-- IMPORTANTE:
		-- Si estamos escribiendo en el chat o en otro TextBox,
		-- NO se leen las teclas del teclado.

		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
				direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
				direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
			end

			--==================================================
			-- SUBIR / BAJAR
			--==================================================

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.yAxis
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.yAxis
			end

		end

		--==================================================
		-- APLICAR MOVIMIENTO
		--==================================================

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit * SPEED
		else
			direction = Vector3.zero
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction

		-- El personaje mira hacia donde apunta la cámara
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame

	end)

	flyButton.Text = "STOP"

end

--==================================================
-- DETENER VUELO
--==================================================

local function stopFly()

	if not flying then
		return
	end

	flying = false

	-- Detener actualización
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end

	-- Eliminar velocidad
	if bodyVelocity then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
		bodyVelocity = nil
	end

	-- Eliminar orientación
	if bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro:Destroy()
		bodyGyro = nil
	end

	-- Recuperar movimiento normal
	local character = player.Character

	if character then

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end

	end

	flyButton.Text = "FLY"

end

--==================================================
-- ACTIVAR / DESACTIVAR
--==================================================

local function toggleFly()

	if flying then
		stopFly()
	else
		startFly()
	end

end

--==================================================
-- DETECTAR CLIC / TOQUE
--==================================================

flyButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		pressed = true
		dragging = false
		dragStarted = false

		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = flyButton.Position

		dragInput = input

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- DETECTAR MOVIMIENTO
--==================================================

flyButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragInput = input

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- FINALIZAR CLIC / TOQUE
--==================================================

flyButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		-- Si NO se arrastró, es un toque normal.
		if pressed and not dragStarted then
			toggleFly()
		end

		pressed = false
		dragging = false
		dragStarted = false
		dragInput = nil

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- ACTUALIZAR ARRASTRE
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not pressed then
		return
	end

	if input ~= dragInput then
		return
	end

	local delta = input.Position - dragStart

	-- Comprobar si se movió suficiente
	if delta.Magnitude >= DRAG_DISTANCE then
		dragStarted = true
		dragging = true
	end

	if dragging then

		flyButton.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,

			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- TECLA E EN PC
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

	-- No activar Fly mientras se escribe
	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		return
	end

	-- Roblox ya está usando esta entrada
	if processed then
		return
	end

	-- E activa/desactiva Fly
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		toggleFly()
	end

end)

--==================================================
-- SI EL PERSONAJE APARECE DE NUEVO
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

	-- Apagar vuelo anterior
	stopFly()

	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		stopFly()
	end)

end)
